brief.summary: All the Voyages work so far is merged into bleeding-edge, but nobody has played it in the Unity editor yet. From here on, the calls are yours. When you make one, write it down in the doc it belongs to.
decisions: Get the squad working first, both solo (three AI teammates that each play their role) and co-op (the networked Ark).
A squad is always three vessels. The number of pilots is however many seats those vessels have.
An AI's role comes from its cards: vessel, pilot, element and artifact. Try three first: Guardian, Cultivator and Destroyer.
The cells look cheap right now: they need a proper nucleus and shards.
Keep the branch list tidy: finish or delete old branches instead of keeping them around.
